guarantees.claim: block_ctr_expr is asserted exactly when block_ctr_q equals zero.
block_ctr_set is high if ctrl_we_q is high, or if block_ctr_decr is high and (block_ctr_q==0 or cipher_prng_reseed_i is high).
block_ctr_set_val is 0 when prng_reseed_rate_i equals PER_1 or when it matches none of PER_1,PER_64,PER_8K; it is 63 for PER_64 and 8191 for PER_8K, all zero-extended or truncated to BlockCtrWidth.
block_ctr_decr_val equals block_ctr_q minus 1 (unsigned subtraction); underflow when block_ctr_q is zero yields all‑ones.
block_ctr_d selects block_ctr_set_val when block_ctr_set is high, else block_ctr_decr_val when block_ctr_decr is high, else holds block_ctr_q; set overrides decrement.

assumptions.claim: Parameter BlockCtrWidth must be at least 13 so that the constant 8191 fits without truncation.
assumptions.cond: when block_ctr_set asserts and prng_reseed_rate_i equals PER_8K
assumptions.risk: Truncation would reduce the reseed interval, causing more frequent PRNG reseeding than intended and potentially weakening post‑reseeding entropy.

assumptions.claim: External logic must not assert block_ctr_decr when block_ctr_q is zero, unless wrapping to all‑ones is the desired behavior.
assumptions.cond: when block_ctr_set is low and block_ctr_decr is high
assumptions.risk: Counter wrap moves block_ctr_expr far into the future, severely delaying the next reseed window and upsetting the PRNG reseed schedule.

uncertain_points.claim: If BlockCtrWidth is less than 13, the cast of 8191 to BlockCtrWidth may truncate the value, silently changing the effective reseed interval.
uncertain_points.risk: PRNG may reseed at wrong epoch boundaries, potentially compromising cryptographic unpredictability.

uncertain_points.claim: prng_reseed_rate_i may have legal encodings beyond PER_1, PER_64, PER_8K; the unconditional fallback to 0 could represent a missing mapping or undesired rapid reseed.
uncertain_points.cond: when prng_reseed_rate_i takes any other valid value
uncertain_points.risk: Reseed every block (set_val=0) would burn PRNG state too fast and may violate the assumed security strength.

uncertain_points.claim: block_ctr_set and block_ctr_decr can be asserted simultaneously; the current priority (set wins) might hide a control conflict that should not occur in normal operation.
uncertain_points.cond: when both block_ctr_set and block_ctr_decr are high
uncertain_points.risk: A state machine flaw could toggle both, leading to unexpected counter loading instead of decrement, breaking the block counting protocol.
